vertebrae.evaluator
===================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.evaluator

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Single-extractor evaluator wrapper.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.evaluator.Evaluator


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: Evaluator(dataset, extractor, **kwargs)

   Single-extractor convenience wrapper around `Benchmark`.

   :param dataset: Dataset object with inputs and labels.
   :param extractor: Feature extractor to evaluate.
   :param \*\*kwargs: Additional keyword arguments forwarded to `Benchmark`.


   .. py:method:: run()

      Run the single-extractor benchmark.

      :returns: A `BenchmarkResult`.
